mapper.select: SELECT donation_id AS donationId, user_id AS userId, title, description, account_info AS accountInfo, max_price AS maxPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM donation WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT donation_id AS donationId, user_id AS userId, title, description, account_info AS accountInfo, max_price AS maxPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM donation WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT donation_id AS donationId, user_id AS userId, title, description, account_info AS accountInfo, max_price AS maxPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, image_path AS imagePath, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM donation WHERE donation_id = #{donationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation ( user_id, title, description, account_info, max_price, current_price, status, reject_reason, image_path, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{accountInfo}, #{maxPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{imagePath}, NOW(), NOW() )
